refinedcreation.configuration.title: Refined Creation Configs
refinedcreation.workbench.sort.name: Name
Place a Logistics Bridge so that it touches a Refined Storage network, directly or through cables
Its sides light up once the network is powered
Place a Packager against the bridge, facing away from it
Attach a Stock Link to the Packager, tuned to your logistics network
Stock Keepers on that network can now see and order every item stored in Refined Storage
Requests are packaged straight out of Refined Storage
Packages delivered to this Packager are unpacked directly into the network
Items Refined Storage can craft are listed as ∞. Ordering more than is stored starts an autocrafting task
refinedcreation.ponder.logistics_dispatc: The Logistics Dispatcher lets Refined Storage autocrafting use a Create factory
Place an Autocrafter facing the dispatcher, and put processing patterns in it
Place a Packager against the dispatcher, facing away, with a sign giving your factory's address
When Refined Storage runs one of those patterns, the ingredients are packed and sent to the factory
Have the factory send its output to the Logistics Bridge's Packager. Refined Storage counts it toward the task
Patterns may only use items, since packages can't carry fluids
refinedcreation.ponder.logistics_workben: The Logistics Workbench is a crafting table that orders its ingredients from a Create logistics network
Right-click it with a tuned Stock Link, or a Stock Link with it before placing, to join that network
Place a Packager against it, facing away, and give the Packager a way to receive packages
Its screen lists everything on the network. Click an item to order it to the workbench
Deliveries are unpacked into the workbench's buffer, ready for the crafting grid
Items on the return shelf are packaged and sent back through the same Packager
